fusions.name: Coughed-Up Swarm
fusions.desc: Spits 3 swallowed stingers in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Tongue-Tip
fusions.desc: Your tongue, tipped with a swallowed stinger, hits the first enemy in its path up to 6 tiles away for 10 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Stinging Spawn
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm of stinging tadpoles that fights for 15 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Hive Never Rests
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, 14 stamina comes back to you. Once every 20 seconds.
